title: The conjunction example repeats its first initial sequent.
details: OPLSS 2023 notes, §10 printed p. 17 (PDF p. 18), derivation of ⇒p→(q→p∧q). The two ∧R premises are both printed p,q⇒p. The second must be p,q⇒q to derive p∧q. It is an immediate initial sequent, so the intended derivation remains valid after this local copy correction. The corpus uses distinct p and q branches and supplies its own complete NJ/LJ translations. No upstream correction is inferred. Current corpus adoption: intuitionistic-propositional-sequents#conjunction-proof. The entry uses the checked correction; no upstream correction is inferred.
